content.user_title: Diagnose Context Degradation in AI Agents
content.value_statement: Long contexts can make AI agents overlook facts, repeat errors, or apply conflicting instructions. This skill identifies common degradation patterns and recommends focused mitigation strategies.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle, poisoning, distraction, confusion, and context clash patterns.
Maps degradation symptoms to likely causes and practical recovery strategies.
Simulates position-based attention risk for demonstration and testing.
Scores context health using utilization, position risk, and poisoning indicators.
Detects heuristic error, contradiction, and uncertain-claim markers in text.
Recommends filtering, compaction, task partitioning, and context isolation.
limitations: Attention values are simulated and do not represent actual model attention weights.
Token counts use simple whitespace splitting instead of model-specific tokenizers.
Poisoning and contradiction checks use basic patterns that can produce false positives.
Published model thresholds may change and should be verified before production use.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Agent Sessions
use_cases.description: Identify why an agent starts ignoring goals or selecting incorrect tools as its conversation grows.

use_cases.title: Design Context Controls
use_cases.description: Choose compaction, filtering, masking, or isolation controls for production agent workflows.

use_cases.title: Plan Context Evaluations
use_cases.description: Define tests that vary context length, information position, distractors, and conflicting sources.

prompt_templates.title: Identify a Degradation Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this agent failure: [failure description]. Identify the most likely context degradation pattern and explain the evidence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis of one observed failure

prompt_templates.title: Recommend a Mitigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this context workflow: [workflow]. Recommend one immediate mitigation and one architectural improvement. Explain which degradation risk each change addresses.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate improvement of an existing workflow

prompt_templates.title: Audit Context Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this context layout: [layout]. Assess critical information placement, irrelevant content, conflicting sources, and accumulated errors. Prioritize the findings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Detailed review of a prompt or agent session

prompt_templates.title: Design a Degradation Evaluation
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evaluation for [agent system]. Vary context length, evidence position, distractor count, and source conflicts. Define metrics, thresholds, and recovery tests.

output_examples.input: A support agent ignores a refund policy placed halfway through a very long context.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: lost in middle. Move the policy near the current task, repeat its key constraint at the end, and test recall by position.

output_examples.input: An agent repeats an incorrect customer status after a failed tool response was summarized as successful.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: context poisoning. Remove the incorrect summary, reload verified tool output, and label the correction before continuing.

output_examples.input: A research agent combines current guidance with an older document that recommends the opposite action.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: context clash. Mark the conflict, apply source and version priority, and exclude the outdated document.

best_practices: Measure task quality across increasing context lengths instead of relying on window size alone.
Keep goals, current constraints, and verified findings near attention-favored positions.
Validate retrieved content and preserve source versions before adding it to context.
anti_patterns: Do not load every available document without relevance filtering.
Do not preserve failed tool outputs as trusted summaries.
Do not mix unrelated tasks and conflicting instructions in one growing context.

faq.question: What is context degradation?
faq.answer: Context degradation is a decline in model performance as context grows, becomes noisy, contains errors, or includes conflicting information.

faq.question: Does a larger context window prevent degradation?
faq.answer: No. A larger window increases capacity, but retrieval quality and reasoning can still decline before the limit.

faq.question: Can this skill measure real attention weights?
faq.answer: No. Its Python utility simulates a position-based attention curve for demonstration.

faq.question: How does the skill detect context poisoning?
faq.answer: It uses simple patterns for errors, contradictions, and uncertain claims. Results require human or model-based verification.

faq.question: Which mitigation should I try first?
faq.answer: Remove irrelevant content, surface current goals, and correct unverified information. Then consider compaction or task isolation.

faq.question: Can I use this with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The diagnostic concepts apply across Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and other long-context agent systems.
